span.label: mechanisms
span.term: building cultural dimensions as averaged vector-differences between antonym word pairs, then projecting words onto them
span.note: Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The method needs a large corpus; subtle and complex cultural associations cannot be recovered from small bodies of text.
span.note: what this limits: any application to a small corpus: WORD EMBEDDINGS ... REQUIRE A RELATIVELY LARGE BODY OF TEXT IF THE OUTPUT VECTOR SPACE IS TO CAPTURE SUBTLE AND COMPLEX ASSOCIATIONS
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Race could not be traced historically because the terminology shifted across the century, so the historical analysis was restricted to gender and class.
span.note: what this limits: the absence of race from the historical analysis: UNDERTAKING THIS TASK EFFECTIVELY WOULD REQUIRE A DEEPER ENGAGEMENT WITH LINGUISTIC SHIFTS IN RACIAL TERMINOLOGY THAN IS FEASIBLE WITHIN THE SPACE CONSTRAINTS - the dimension is omitted for a vocabulary reason
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The validating survey used a Mechanical Turk sample that is not representative of the US population.
span.note: what this limits: the survey validation specifically: OUR SAMPLE CANNOT BE SAID TO BE REPRESENTATIVE OF THE GENERAL POPULATION OF THE UNITED STATES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: Embedding projections capture semantic association in text, not material or on-the-ground social realities.
span.note: what this limits: every substantive claim about culture: WORD EMBEDDINGS MODELS, BY DISTILLING INFORMATION FROM LOCAL WORD CO-OCCURRENCES, DO NOT PROVIDE DIRECT INFORMATION ABOUT MATERIAL, ON-THE-GROUND REALITIES
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The confidence intervals depend on treating books and newspapers as independent draws from a population of cultural observations, which is stated as a condition rather than shown.
span.note: what this limits: the confidence or credible intervals reported for distances and projections here: they follow from assuming the underlying texts are i.i.d. observations drawn from a population of cultural observations
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: The method the paper displaces is criticised on reproducibility, which is the ground on which the new one is offered.
span.note: what this limits: the comparison between close reading and embedding-based analysis: close reading is credited with advancing the field and criticised for clear limitations in reproducibility
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.

span.label: the interpretation space sampled SYSTEMATICALLY - 1,775 antonym pairs taken from WordNet - rather than by selecting salient dimensions, with the reported dimensions restricted to those at the smallest angle to the focal ones
span.note: eliminates: CHERRY-PICKING BY THE ANALYST. The paper names the charge it is answering: that researchers 'conveniently cherry-pick explanations to confirm pre-existing opinions'. An unsupervised model yields far more readable structure than any paper reports, so the choice of what to report is where the freedom lives
Quotation withheld because this record is not cleared for redistribution.
